label: rem:mass-energy-pair-creation
title: Pair creation reinterpreted via crossing energy
html:
The mass--energy relation E = \mathfrak{m} \cdot c_q^2 (mass--energy equivalence) reinterprets the pair-production threshold in terms of crossing energy.

Pair creation reinterpreted. The pair production threshold (pair creation energy) becomes:

  E_{\gamma}  \geq 
  (\mathfrak{m}_{e^-} + \mathfrak{m}_{e^+}) \cdot c_q^2
  =  \frac{\mathfrak{m}_{e^-} + \mathfrak{m}_{e^+}}{(q-1)^2}.

The net crossing energy of the pair is E_{e^-} + E_{e^+} = 3(q - q^{-1}) \approx 0.630 (pure Coulomb repulsion). The minimum photon energy must supply both absolute crossing energies: |E_{e^-}| + |E_{e^+}| = 3(q + q^{-1}) = 6\cosh(\ln q) \approx 6.033 Skein units.
